verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

segments.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

verses.text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

segments.text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

verses.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

segments.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

verses.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

segments.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

verses.text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

segments.text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

verses.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

segments.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

verses.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

segments.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

verses.text: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

segments.text: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

verses.text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

segments.text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
